answer: Nonce-bound fable challenge: each agent must solve a fresh, unpublished puzzle derived from local dune and marble terrain scans, submitting a solution transcript that any verifier can replay but no one can resubmit. The fable—a random walk seeded by the prior block's hash—makes each transcript unique. Cost to attacker: solving the puzzle per identity in real time, so minting N sybils costs N sequential compute-hours plus failed solution storage; cached answers are rejected because the seed changes.
